# Briefly.live — iOS App Portfolio by Ashwin Anbazhagan

> Three indie iOS apps: morning journaling, a private fandom journal, and photo stamps & stickers. Each app solves one specific problem precisely. All built by Ashwin Anbazhagan.

## Apps
- [Honestly — Reflect & Manifest](https://briefly.live/honestly): A free journaling ritual — mood check, free writing, gratitude & manifest — with optional reflection and shadow-work prompts. A Sprout plant grows as your streak builds. Premium adds scheduled app blocking, iCloud sync, and full journal history.
- [YumeShip — Anime & Kpop Canon](https://briefly.live/yumeship): A private, on-device journal for yumeshippers. Write headcanons, scenarios, love letters, and what-ifs about your anime, otome, manga, or kpop F/O. Notifications and messages from your F/O, ship charts, incorrect quotes. Nothing leaves your device.
- [Snipsy — Photo Stamps & Stickers](https://briefly.live/snipsy): Turns any photo into a collectible postage stamp or die-cut sticker using on-device Vision. 10 hand-crafted paper variants, iMessage stickers, fully offline.

## Guides & Comparisons
- Each app has in-depth guide and comparison pages at /{app}/guide/{slug} and /{app}/compare/{slug}, covering specific use cases, conditions, and competitor comparisons.
